_comment: Pinned baseline for scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py. Every count here was MEASURED on one host and one toolchain, not derived analytically -- treat them as host-dependent facts to be re-verified, not universal truths. `tests` and `failures` are gating: the run must match both exactly (higher OR lower than recorded is a FAIL -- see the module docstring for why). `skipped` is informational only; the gate records and displays it but never fails on a skipped-count mismatch, because XCTest's own skip conditions (platform/build-flag guards inside the projected sources) can legitimately vary the skip count without indicating a defect in this gate. `swift_testing` pins the SEPARATE Swift Testing (`@Test`) leg for the same target -- `tests` and `failures` are both gating, in either direction, exactly like the XCTest fields; 0 is a real, checked pin (see the module docstring's zero-case vacuity trap), not an absence of coverage. To regenerate after an intentional change to the projected suites: run `python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py --update-expectations`, read the printed warning, diff this file against the previous commit, and only commit the diff after confirming each changed number by hand -- this command RECORDS whatever the run currently produced, it does not validate that the new numbers are correct.

_provenance.method: python3 scripts/export_public_repository.py --development-projection (967 files); each target built individually and its .xctest bundle run directly via this gate (scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py). The 2565-test / 75-failure predecessor baseline had been corroborated three independent ways (swift test --filter, direct xcrun xctest, and this gate), all agreeing. This re-baseline is the same gate re-run after an exclusion change; the gate CORRECTLY reported MISMATCH against the old baseline first (a drop in failures fails too, by design), and these numbers are what it then measured. Total: 2519 tests, 0 failures across all 8 targets.
_provenance.scope: The 8 MLX-free projected test targets only. SpikeCoreTests, FastMLXHarnessTests, ExactPrefixMLXTests, SpikeServingAdaptersTests (MLX/Metal targets) and the vendored MLXLMTests package are not covered here.

Again one target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is exactly the 9 test methods added to OpenAIChatCompletionsTests.swift for the chat_template_kwargs allowlist-forward + visible-drop fix. Reconciled two ways before editing (a third, CI's own measurement, is not available pre-publish): counting added `func test` methods in the diff (+9, 0 removed) and a local `swift test --package-path spike --filter ServingCoreTests` run measuring 735 with 2 skipped and 0 failures. Moved in the SAME increment as the tests, which is the lesson cycle 128 paid for: every local gate in the cycle contract is blind to this file, so a green dev suite does not imply a green public gate. The 2026-09-17 provenance above still describes how the other seven targets' numbers were obtained. 2026-09-24 (cycle 156): HarnessCoreTests 1320 -> 1330. One target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is the 10 NET XCTest methods cycle 155 added to QualityAdmissionTests.swift for the duplicate-card-id identity-tuple fix and the empty-manifest count fragment. WORTH RECORDING, because this pin was nearly missed: cycle 155 COMMITTED those tests but never PUBLISHED them and never touched this file, so cycle 156 inherited an unpublished delta its own diff did not contain. Cycle 156's first reconciliation reasoned only about the single test IT added (in SpikeServingAdaptersTests, correctly out of scope per _provenance/scope) and concluded 'no pin moves' -- true of its own diff, false of the tree being published. THE DELTA IS AGAINST THE LAST PUBLISHED TREE, NOT AGAINST THIS CYCLE'S DIFF. Reconciled two independent ways: `func test` count in QualityAdmissionTests.swift, 90 at the last published commit 775384fa vs 100 in the published tree (+10); and CI run 36061052388's own measurement, `MISMATCH (tests 1330 (expected 1320), failures 0 (expected 0))`, 7/8 targets OK. swift_testing stays 49, measured 49 ACT / 49 EXP OK in that same run, confirming all ten additions are XCTest methods.

HarnessCoreTests.note: Re-baselined 2026-09-17 after the projected suite was made green. Was 1307 tests / 75 failures: 47 projected cases depended on assets the projection does not ship, so they are now excluded from the public projection. One new case was added in their place, pinning a refusal branch that the exclusion made newly reachable to test with only projected assets. Net -46 = -47 excluded +1 new. MEASURED by this gate, not derived. 2026-09-19: +9 residency-admission cases in QualityAdmissionTests (31 -> 40 test methods by source count); public CI run 35425151339 MEASURED 1270 tests, 0 failures, before this pin moved. 2026-09-22: +6 hardwareClass identity/tiebreak cases in QualityAdmissionTests (40 -> 46 test methods by source count); public CI run 35756698915 MEASURED 1276 tests, 0 failures, before this pin moved. The XCTest leg moves and swift_testing stays 49 because all six new cases are XCTest methods. This pin is invisible to the four local publication gates and to the development suite -- only the projected Swift run measures it, which is why it is moved on a MEASURED CI count and never on a local assertion. 2026-09-22 (cycle 135): 1276 -> 1280. One target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is exactly the 4 XCTest methods added to QualityAdmissionTests.swift (46 -> 50 test methods by source count) for the fail-closed ordering fix -- host class is a tiebreak WITHIN a verdict class, so an exact host match can no longer outrank a published NO_GO. Reconciled three ways before editing: counting added `func test` methods in the diff (+4, 0 removed); a local development-tree `swift test --package-path spike --filter HarnessCoreTests` run measuring 1327 XCTest / 0 failures alongside 49 Swift Testing / 0 failures; and -- unlike cycles 128/129, which had no pre-publish measurement available -- a LOCAL run of this very gate against a fresh projection, `python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py --target HarnessCoreTests`, which MEASURED 1280 tests / 0 failures and correctly reported MISMATCH against the 1276 pin before this edit. That local projected run is the strongest available pre-publish evidence and is reproducible without a failed publish; prefer it over waiting for CI to measure the number. `swift_testing` stays 49 because all four new cases are XCTest methods, which that same run independently confirmed (49 ACT / 49 EXP, OK). 2026-09-23 (cycle 144): 1280 -> 1308. MEASURED by a LOCAL run of this very gate against a fresh projection (`python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py`), which reproduced the FAILED public CI run 35834387367 EXACTLY (1308 tests, 0 failures) before this pin moved -- that local run is the pre-publish check this file's own note already recommends, and cycle 144 skipped it and was caught by CI for it. Reconciled two independent ways: measured delta +28, and `func test` methods in QualityAdmissionTests.swift 50 -> 78 (+28) by source count. `git diff --stat` over `spike/Tests/**` since the last pin commit (8de6a991) shows EXACTLY two changed files, so the whole delta is attributable with nothing unexplained. Accumulated across cycles 142-144, which each added cases without moving this pin. swift_testing stays 49: every added case is an XCTest method. 2026-09-23 (cycle 151): 1308 -> 1313. One target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is exactly the 5 XCTest methods added to QualityAdmissionTests.swift (78 -> 83 by source count) for the per-card manifest decode leniency that stops ONE malformed card from throwing out of the whole manifest decode and silently disarming the gate for every pack. Reconciled three ways before editing: source count 78 -> 83 (+5); `git diff` showing +5 `func test` added and 0 removed; and a LOCAL run of this very gate against a fresh projection, `python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py --target HarnessCoreTests`, which MEASURED 1313 tests / 0 failures and correctly reported MISMATCH against the 1308 pin before this edit. METHOD TRAP worth recording for whoever moves this pin next: the FIRST such local run this cycle was launched with the changes still UNCOMMITTED and measured 1308 -- it reproduced the OLD pin and reported OK -- because export_public_repository.py reads the git INDEX, not the working tree. Stage or commit the change before running this gate, or it will silently confirm the very number you are trying to move. swift_testing stays 49: all five added cases are XCTest methods, which that same run independently confirmed (49 ACT / 49 EXP, OK). The two cases added to MLXScalarServingTests.swift move no pin -- SpikeServingAdaptersTests is an MLX/Metal target outside this gate's 8-target scope. 2026-09-24 (cycle 154): 1313 -> 1320. One target, one number, hand-confirmed rather than regenerated. The delta is the 7 NET XCTest methods added to QualityAdmissionTests.swift (83 -> 90 by source count) for the fix that stops a card malformed ONLY in `admission` from failing the gate OPEN (a dropped card is an absent card, and `decide(card: nil,)` admits). NOTE the net: 8 `func test` were ADDED and 1 was REMOVED -- the old `...ThrowsKeyNotFoundOnOptIn` reachability control, re-based onto `verdict` because the change makes `optIn` stop throwing BY DESIGN. A naive +8 would have mis-set this pin to 1321. Reconciled three ways before editing: source count 83 -> 90 (+7); `git diff` showing +8 `func test` and -1; and a LOCAL run of this very gate against a fresh projection with the change STAGED, `python3 scripts/run_projected_test_suites.py --target HarnessCoreTests`, which MEASURED 1320 tests / 0 failures and correctly reported `MISMATCH (tests 1320 (expected 1313))` BEFORE this edit -- the honest order, and the pre-publish check this note already recommends. swift_testing stays 49: that leg measured 49 ACT / 49 EXP OK in the same run, independently confirming all seven additions are XCTest methods. The two re-based cases in MLXScalarServingTests.swift move no pin -- SpikeServingAdaptersTests is an MLX/Metal target outside this gate's 8-target scope.
